Wow! I used this product for the first time last night and am very impressed with the results. I slept with the mask on for the majority of the night and when I woke up, my skin felt soft and rejuvenated and when I looked in the mirror, I was even more pleasantly surprised by the results!

I highly recommend Sungboon Editor masks!

I have used many masks over the past 10+ years. This one by far is the best. I only used it for 40 minutes. The serum in the mask was quickly absorbed after I removed the mask. My face was noticeably brighter. I used the mask at night. The next morning, my face was still brighter than usual. My serum, moisturizer, and primer quickly absorbed into my skin. My foundation went on very smoothly. Lines and wrinkles were somewhat smoother after just one use. I really like this mask and just gave one to a friend for her to try. Definitely will be repurchasing these masks.

avis.titre: Makes my skin look plumpy, glowy, healthy and hydrated!
avis.texte: They give me a beautiful glow! Makes my skin look plumpy, glowy, healthy and hydrated. If I've been low on sleep or traveling, they make me look well-rested which is what I like the most. I think it stays in place adhered to my skin really well. But if you wear it during the day and try to eat and chew, it may move a bit. I prefer to put it on before I go to bed and take it off in the morning. I've been using them like once a week for a couple months, haven't had any irritation at all. In combination with my skincare routine, I think these masks help prevent fine lines more than reverse them. I like them so much that I told my mom and my sister about them and now they use them too.
